text:
maria-ramirez: heads-up: seeing steady memory growth on kv-cache hosts serving long chat sessions (~>12k tokens). eviction counters tick but residency stays high. attaching quick profiler output

aj: which eviction metric are you watching? kv.evictions_total or the bucketed ones?

maria-ramirez: quick paste from prod-sampler (6h window):
```
kv.residency_pct: 94 -> 94.5
kv.evictions_total: 120 -> 124
kv.hit_rate: 0.82 -> 0.79
heap_rss: +1.2GB over 6h
kv.eviction_by_bucket: {0-1m:2,1-10m:1,10m-1h:0,>1h:121}
```

zhee: interesting - evictions do happen but almost all are very old entries (>1h). That smells like fragmentation/uneven reuse rather than aggressive LRU churn. Could be small fragments getting reused so pages never free.

simon-lee: also check kernel selection logs. Last week we saw q8_fast_attn pick remove the compact path in favor of speed; that can leave pages in an uncompactable layout.

perf-bot: perf-alert: kv-cache-memory-growth-service: p95 mem delta 1.1GB/6h (rule: kv.mem.growth > 0.8GB/6h)

aj: can you share a repro workload? i can run a local harness with long-prefix chats and variable reply sizes. I'll dump page_refcounts and frag reuse counts.

maria-ramirez: ran a small repro on staging. flame shows most time in page_walk during eviction path. kernel-selection log shows: "kernel_variant=q8_fast_attn, compact_path=disabled"

maria-ramirez: repro command:
```
./tools/kv_profiler --trace long-chat --duration 1h --out flame_longchat.svg
```

zhee: proposal for observability additions:
- kv.page_fragmentation_ratio (total_frag_bytes / total_alloc_bytes)
- kv.frag_reuse_hits and kv.frag_reuse_accesses -> frag_reuse_rate = hits / accesses
- kv.residency_age_buckets (0-1h, 1-6h, >6h)
- kv.evictions_by_reason tag (memory_pressure|frag_compaction|ttl)

simon-lee: +1 to kv.residency_age_buckets. Also want kernel_variant and batch_size as labels on eviction/ residency metrics so we can pivot.

aj: practical quick win: add a lightweight per-request sampler that emits header: kernel_variant, batch_size, kv.page_reads, kv.page_writes. we'll aggregate for 1m windows. I'll prototype.

maria-ramirez: dashboard ask: correlate evictions_per_min with batch_size_hist and kernel_variant. if large batches correlate with high residency we might clamp batch size for long-chat paths.

zhee: can we compute frag_reuse_rate online? counter increments on frag reuse will be cheap. then we can alert on frag_reuse_rate < 0.2 for long sessions.

aj: i'll add a sampling exporter that emits: {kernel_variant, batch_size, kv.page_reads, kv.page_writes, kv.frag_reuse_hits, kv.frag_reuse_accesses} as metrics with the request_id tag. Should be low overhead if sampled 1/1000.

maria-ramirez: created ticket INF-8423 with repro artifacts, logs and flame: https://redwood.example.com/t/INF-8423. pinging @eng-runtime for visibility :eyes:

zhee: :thumbsup: i'll mock metrics and add grafana panels for: frag_reuse_rate, residency_age_heatmap, evictions_by_reason. prioritizing frag_reuse_rate as high-signal.

simon-lee: maybe follow-up: add an eviction compaction pass when kernel_variant disables compact path. conditional fallback where we accept a bit more CPU on eviction to keep residency <= target.

aj: ack, i'll push prototype sampler and a small PR to emit frag_reuse counters. will tag INF-8423.

maria-ramirez: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage.
